Interface EntityEncoder<A>

Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface EntityEncoder<A>
How to write an A as a body: a type class, so Ok(value) finds the encoder for the value's type at compile time.

The instances here are the defaults, found without imports. A closer given (in the handler, the class, or imported) wins. There is deliberately no JSON instance: JSON comes from forj-http-json's explicit json(value), so a String is never turned into JSON by an import.
